description: Retrieves Posts from the full archive matching a search query. At most one of `start_time`, `since_id` may be provided. At most one of `end_time`, `until_id` may be provided. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com. The search string is query, not q. Date operators are since:YYYY-MM-DD or since:YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS_UTC (UTC only).

expansions.description: A comma separated list of fields to expand.
